name: un-comtrade-mcp-server
description: UN Comtrade international trade statistics via MCP. Country/HS lookups, flows, balances, rankings.

comtrade_clamp_limits.title: Clamp trade page limits
comtrade_clamp_limits.description: Serve up to 1,000 goods or services records when a larger page is requested. Disable to reject oversized page requests.

comtrade_subscription_key.title: UN Comtrade Subscription Key
comtrade_subscription_key.description: Azure API Management key from comtradedeveloper.un.org. Optional — without it, tools fall back to the public preview endpoint (500-record cap).
